integrity.proof_basis: Two-scale asymptotic analysis of the exact zero-flip multiplier; numerical experiments are not used as proof.

scientific_limitations: Fixed B>0 and y>0 only; no uniformity as y tends to zero.
The asymptotic concerns the specified shifted-sinc profile and its zeros n/B+iy, not arbitrary Paley-Wiener functions.
The phase-optimized distance is treated asymptotically; no finite-n exact identity is claimed.
title: A sharp inverse-index law for distant zero flips of a bandlimited sinc profile
